attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses his own assessment.

semantics.note: The firm rejection of half being installed expresses a present factual position. The normalisation preserves the threshold and shipped cohort.

contract.note: Physical installation is an ordinary reading. The contract preserves the original shipment cohort and publication date. The unresolved result does not depend on distinguishing racked GPUs from commissioned GPUs.

evidence.note: The model implies installations above the threshold, even after subtracting the roughly 0.2 million later shipments. Its assumed deployment lag lacks corroboration, so it cannot settle the outcome.
Explains the assumptions behind e1. It supplies no independent installation count and weakens confidence in the model.
Relevant background about installation constraints. This reported Microsoft disclosure gives neither a Blackwell count nor the share of the specified cohort installed.
Accurately presented as an earlier NVIDIA disclosure. A deployment rate before the target period cannot establish cumulative physical installations without assumptions about duration and meaning.

reviews.rationale: The only quantitative counterestimate depends on assumed deployment lags and lacks corroboration. The remaining evidence supplies no comparable installed total. The packet establishes neither side of the 1.5 million threshold by publication.
